references.text: Balak sends messengers to Balaam the first time with a similar request to come and curse Israel.
Balaam finally goes with Balak's men after the Lord gives him permission.
Balaam confirms that Balak brought him from Aram to curse Jacob.
Moses reminds the Israelites that Balak hired Balaam to curse them, but the Lord turned the curse into a blessing.
Joshua reminds the people how Balak sent for Balaam to curse Israel.
Nehemiah refers to Balak hiring Balaam to curse Israel.
Micah reminds the people what Balak planned and what Balaam answered.
Peter warns against Balaam's way, who loved the wages of unrighteousness.
Jude mentions Balaam's error which false teachers follow for gain.
Jesus rebukes the church in Pergamon for holding to Balaam's teaching.
